statements.text: In the 2013 formulation, the existence of a Markov blanket at steady state means that internal states minimize a free energy functional of blanket states, so that the density they encode matches the conditional density over external states.

standing.reason: Published counterexamples show the 2013 lemma does not hold at face value. Later formulations of the principle state it differently, so this rejects the 2013 statement only.

sources.quote: The existence of a Markov blanket means that internal states will appear to minimize a free energy functional of the states of their Markov blanket.
